content.comment_body: Hello all, I've run into an issue with the Data Log function in my controller setup. For two days, I received reports as expected, but today the system stopped working and displayed 'No data log is found.' I'm using a [product_name] PLC with a memory card inserted, and nothing in my setup has changed between when it worked and now. Any advice on resolving this would be appreciated!
The reference '24RCEo' doesn't provide enough detail. It's better if you include the full order number. Have you checked the diagnostic section? Navigate to Tools > Transfer > Diagnostic.

I'm also experiencing difficulty with a [article_no] controller, encountering the same 'No data log found' error. When functioning, it generates 9 csv files with 20,000 records each before stopping. Using [product_name] Tools > Transfer > Upload Data Log, I get the message 'No data log found.' After ejecting the SD card, removing the files, and reinserting it, data logging does not resume. Clearing the user program and password, then reloading, sometimes restores logging, but it only creates 9 log files before failing again, despite ample SD card space. Diagnostic screens return no useful information. Due to these issues, I'm hesitant to recommend this solution for applications needing local logging. If a permanent solution is identified, please share.
I'm using a [article_no] device and have tried all recommended steps, including clearing the SD card. The Diagnostic section remains empty.
After formatting the SD card, one Data Log file is generated, but now any upload results in the same log being created repeatedly.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report persistent failures with the Data Log function on [product_name] PLC devices that use memory cards. While logging works initially, it unexpectedly stops and displays a 'No data log is found' error message. Troubleshooting steps like SD card formatting or program reloading only fix the issue temporarily; the problem returns, causing ongoing frustration and doubts about the feature's reliability. Diagnostic tools fail to provide helpful information, making it difficult for users to resolve the problem.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliable, uninterrupted data logging, more effective diagnostic features, and simple recovery from errors without complicated manual procedures.
